## Checklist

- [ ] This pull request does one thing, and its title needs no "and"
- [ ] I ran `bun run check` and `bun run format`, and CI is green
- [ ] I checked open pull requests for overlapping files and linked related
      issues
- [ ] The last commit refreshes the Graphify graph (`graphify update .`)
- [ ] I read my whole diff, including anything an AI agent wrote
- [ ] UI follows `docs/DESIGN.md`, with no browser-native inputs or selects
- [ ] I updated the docs if behaviour changed, or none were affected
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` files or real buyer data are included
